fact: The adopted law creates an independent administrative data-protection authority responsible for enforcement; the document does not say it has been constituted.
The law establishes an independent administrative authority to oversee personal data protection, and a dedicated body to implement and monitor data protection regimes; no appointment is reported.
The law establishes an independent administrative authority to oversee data protection; the article does not say the authority has been constituted. Law promulgated 10 March 2026.

Levellers says the data protection law of 10 March 2026 creates a Personal Data Protection Agency but leaves its missions and organisation to a later decree, and no operational authority was identified.
